title: Public swarms
lede: A swarm is a group of machines that share model inference over a peer-to-peer network. This list shows the swarms whose owners chose to make them public. Anyone with a swarm's token can join it.
tokenTitle: The start and the end of the token. Copy it from How to join.
warning: The Explorer is a community list of swarm tokens. Anyone can use a token to send work to a swarm or share resources with it. Use at your own risk.

empty.title: No swarm has workers online
empty.text: Only swarms with at least one online worker are listed. List yours to make it public.

off.title: This server is not an explorer
off.text: The Explorer page needs a LocalAI server started in explorer mode. This one has no list of swarms to show.

error.title: Could not load the swarms
error.text: The explorer server did not answer. Check that it is running, then try again.

join.title: Join {{name}}
join.text: Start a LocalAI worker with this swarm's token.
join.federated: Federated cluster {{id}}. Start a node on it with either command.
join.noCommands: This swarm's workers share compute over its token. The token above is what a node needs to join.

list.title: List a swarm
list.text: Add a swarm to the public list. It appears once it has an online worker.
list.name: Name
list.tokenHint: The swarm's network token, as the server printed it.
list.public: Listing publishes the token. Anyone who sees the list can use your swarm's workers.
list.understood: I understand the token becomes public.
